issues.reason: The fusion half falls to the calibration line: the Kestrel-River / Brindle-estuary rule presupposes the capitalized run NAMES the referent, which "Senate" does not (applying it mechanically yields the falsehood (Member senate wing), as the reviewer's own first gap concedes), and senate_wing plus its genus emit nothing false, ill-typed or over-asserted; the half that stands is that "Senate" is a proper noun the text mentions and the parse leaves it with no symbol and no mandatory Name fact.

(Inheritance senate_wing wing) is true, well-typed (kind on both sides) and is exactly the genus the compound-kind route requires of any fused symbol, so it is not itself a defect — it inherits only whatever the disputed fusion is worth.

gaps_confirmed: a capitalized proper-noun modifier naming an ASSOCIATED entity rather than the referent itself ("the Senate wing"): the name rule mechanically yields (Member senate wing) + (Name senate "Senate"), which falsely says the Senate is a wing, and no alternative is given — the possessor/whole PartOf route does not fit either, since the wing is part of the Capitol, not of the Senate

modal / non-intersective attributive adjective ("a possible biohazard") — no licensed encoding; the copular-modal wrap (Might (Member ...)) is being extended to an NP-internal modifier, leaving the witness with no unhedged class atom
episodic bare-plural subject ("authorities later said ...") — the determiner rule routes every bare plural to the generic / kind reading, but this is one specific past event
an adverb of pure sequence ("later") yielding a Before atom — the canonical ordering head fits, but no rule names an adverb as an ordering trigger
new_gaps: a witness minted for a hedged NP is still asserted to exist at full strength: sk_biohazard_1 is (Theme sk_detect_1 sk_biohazard_1) at 1.0 0.99 while the same sentence reports it was a false alarm, and there is no licensed way to hedge or retract the witness itself rather than only its class atom
notes: No repair is available that improves the parse: (Member senate wing) would be false, a bare (Name senate "Senate") would dangle unconnected, and Possession / PartOf have no trigger in a bare noun-noun compound — the repair rule bars inventing an encoding to fill the gap. The "after" ordering with no connective atom, the surface But head, event anaphora to sk_detect_1, and the false_alarm decomposition kept outside the seal are all correct.
